package openfields_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	gensample "open-fields.example/gen/sample"
)

func TestGeneratedStrictCodecPreservesOpenMembers(t *testing.T) {
	raw := []byte(`{"integer":9007199254740993123456789}`)
	q := &gensample.Question{Message: "Choose", Extensions: map[string]json.RawMessage{"extra": raw, "MESSAGE": json.RawMessage(`"extra value"`)}}
	data, err := gensample.EncodeQuestion(q)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Contains(data, append([]byte(`"extra":`), raw...)) || bytes.Contains(data, []byte(`"Extensions"`)) {
		t.Fatalf("encoder changed field placement: %s", data)
	}
	got, err := gensample.DecodeQuestion(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got.Extensions["MESSAGE"], q.Extensions["MESSAGE"]) || got.Message != q.Message || !bytes.Equal(got.Extensions["extra"], raw) {
		t.Fatalf("codec lost open member: %#v", got)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedStrictDecodePreservesCaseDistinctMembers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, data := range []string{`{"message":"known","MESSAGE":"extra"}`, `{"MESSAGE":"extra","message":"known"}`} {
		got, err := gensample.DecodeQuestion([]byte(data))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if got.Message != "known" || string(got.Extensions["MESSAGE"]) != `"extra"` {
			t.Fatalf("changed members: %#v", got)
		}
	}
}
